text:
The diagram shows a wire hanging vertically between the poles of a magnet.
N
S
There is a current in the wire in the direction shown. The wire moves into the plane of the page
away from the observer.
In which direction does the wire move when the current is reversed?
A
The wire moves into the plane of the page, away from the observer.
B
The wire moves to the left.
C
The wire moves to the right.
D
The wire moves out of the plane of the page, towards the observer.

options.label: A
options.text: The wire moves into the plane of the page, away from the observer.
